name: 3w
title: 3w · 3world — free 3D city models & open asset marketplace
description: Free 3D models of any city, starting with NYC and Toronto. Geocodes a place (Nominatim), pulls building footprints + heights from OpenStreetMap (Overpass), and extrudes them into a ready-to-use OBJ model — no keys, no cost. Catalogs the official free city 3D datasets (NYC 3D Building Massing, Toronto 3D Massing, Overture buildings). The marketplace side (3world) starts with Poly Haven's CC0 model catalog and will grow into a free, open 3D-asset exchange. Stdlib-only.
